metric: Queries Calcite can answer from a materialized view that KumoSQL rewrites over the view and proves equivalent; 41 of 41 'cannot' cases (and 8 disabled ones) are not rewritten. Supported subset: 109/139.
correctness: 0 wrong: every rewrite is proven by the prover and re-run against the original on random DuckDB databases (105 verified, 7 not runnable: FLOOR-TO-unit)
usefulness: 112 of 196 queries changed (109 expected, 3 in cases Calcite disables); 105 of 112 verified on random databases
held_out: 27/39 reusable (held-out quarter by case-id hash; 28 rewrites, 26 verified, 0 wrong); development 82/108, baseline (existing prover alone) 8/108
caveats: Calcite's noMat is not a proof that no rewrite exists, so a rewrite where Calcite says noMat would be checked, not penalised (none occurred). Two ok() tests whose asserted plan never reads the view (Funcs17, Funcs20) are scored as cannot-cases. Developed on the development split; 17 cases use shapes the engine does not read (outer/UKFK joins, INTERSECT ALL, branchwise set-op compensation, DML). Adapted shared-model cases are scored separately (20/20 reusable, 9/9 cannot, 0 wrong).
